statutory.label: neutral
statutory.reasoning: Section 31 U.S.C. § 5318(g) requires a covered person to file a suspicious activity report when a transaction involves funds derived from illegal activity, is structured to evade reporting, or is otherwise suspicious, and the report must be filed within 30 days of detection. The fact pattern lists numerous high‑value transactions but does not indicate that any transaction involves illicit source funds, structuring, or other suspicious conduct; it only shows normal import‑export activity. Consequently, the facts do not satisfy the statutory elements of suspicious activity, and the available facts provide not enough data to determine whether the conduct falls within the reporting regime.
